proposal.reason: Main change is transport-selection behavior: intra-node P2P/SHM now defer to NET when topology bandwidth/affinity checks say NET is better, wired through p2p/shm/net canConnect paths. There is also an independent network/proxy change (batched proxy op intake, larger per-peer proxy pool, abort-aware proxy socket init, and shutdown progress behavior). Topology/path handling is substantively changed as well (new PATH_NET classification, reordered path computation/trim semantics, and path-array cleanup on node removal), requiring device-topology review.
